hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && pos check --write >&2 || exit 1; echo '=== Personal OS: auto-injected state ==='; for f in 00-meta/current-context.md 00-meta/generated/block-state.md 00-meta/block-sync.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" && echo; done; LOG="00-meta/sessions/$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md"; [ -f "$LOG" ] && echo '## Today (last 50 lines)' && tail -n 50 "$LOG"; echo '=== Next: read 00-meta/agent-soul.md ==='
